objects.name: a folded stack of evening papers
a camel-hair overcoat on a hook

secret.description: Wilhelm Hauck meets the victim alone in the Victim's Suite from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM and asks for money.
Hedwig Lindemann is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.
Carmela Grasso drinks alone in the Bar from 10:00 PM to 10:30 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.
Margarethe Wehrle hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Kitchen at 10:30 PM.

motive.description: blamed the victim for a ruin

secret.description: Rivka Weisglass slips out to the Street from 10:00 PM to 10:30 PM to settle with a bookmaker.
Constance Havemeyer is alone with Prudence Stannard in the Service Stairs from 10:30 PM, and kills Prudence Stannard at 10:30 PM.

method.name: strangling with a cord
method.bodyEvidence: A ligature furrow across the throat. Three fibres of hemp in the skin.

environment.radioContent: a talk on the tariff by a congressman
environment.radioOutcome: the congressman lost his place and had to start a page over

Prudence Stannard was found on the Service Stairs. The coroner puts death between 10:00 PM and 10:30 PM. A ligature furrow across the throat. Three fibres of hemp in the skin.
A length of sash cord is missing from the Kitchen. A cut end of the same hemp is still tied to the fitting it was taken from.
Rain began at 7:30 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
The passenger elevator was out of order from 10:00 PM to 10:30 PM. Anyone changing floors in that time used the service stairs.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Prudence Stannard's sleeve; Prudence Stannard was on the stairs at 10:30 PM.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Wilhelm Hauck's sleeve; Wilhelm Hauck was on the stairs at 10:00 PM.
The service stairs were whitewashed that afternoon. There is whitewash on Constance Havemeyer's sleeve; Constance Havemeyer was on the stairs at 10:30 PM.

Giovanna Marchetti says the bar radio carried a talk on the tariff by a congressman at 10:00 PM, and that the congressman lost his place and had to start a page over. Anyone in the bar could tell you that.
Hedwig Lindemann's papers do not hold up. The registration card gives an address in Buffalo. There is no such street in Buffalo.
Found in the Front Desk: A clipping about the failure of Margarethe Wehrle's business, with Prudence Stannard's name underlined twice in pencil.
Hedwig Lindemann says Margarethe Wehrle said Prudence Stannard had taken everything and would be made to feel it.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A draft codicil in Prudence Stannard's hand striking Constance Havemeyer out of the will, dated last Tuesday and unsigned.
Giovanna Marchetti says Prudence Stannard told Constance Havemeyer the lawyer was coming Thursday and that the arrangement would be changed.
